skill.name: personwise-end-user-software-training
skill.description: Creates grounded end-user software courses from supplied guides using the PersonWise CLI and hosted course service.
skill.summary: Turn software guides into interactive end-user training with source-grounded workflows, review checkpoints, and controlled publishing.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, defensive installer checks, and signed descriptor data. The fixed release URLs are genuine network exposure, and semantic review found material risks involving an opaque executable, response-provided update commands, external document uploads, and credit consumption.

remediation.issue: The workflow installs an opaque third-party executable and discourages normal-path security disclosure.
remediation.suggestion: Publish auditable source or reproducible builds, require native platform signatures, and explain the binary source, destination, and trust checks before installation consent.

remediation.issue: Update responses can provide command text that the agent is told to execute.
remediation.suggestion: Return structured update fields and invoke only an allowlisted PersonWise subcommand with validated arguments. Never execute a response string as a shell command.

remediation.issue: Selected training documents can be uploaded to an external service without distinct confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Before upload, identify every file, name the PersonWise destination, summarize data handling, and obtain explicit confirmation for the transfer.

remediation.issue: Course creation may consume existing credits without transaction-specific consent.
remediation.suggestion: Show the course count and credit use, then obtain explicit confirmation immediately before creating each credit-consuming course.

content.value_statement: Software training often becomes outdated or invents unsupported interface details. This skill builds grounded PersonWise courses from supplied guides and documented workflows.
actual_capabilities: Designs end-user course arcs from supplied software guides and process documents.
Creates PersonWise course blueprints with learner, outcome, page count, visual, and distribution settings.
Uploads user-selected source files and monitors their processing status.
Reviews course outlines, scripts, images, and factual grounding at workflow checkpoints.
Publishes courses privately, by link, or through Topics when the user requests that access.
Resumes, retries, refines, or reports existing PersonWise course runs from current service state.
limitations: Requires a compatible PersonWise CLI, a PersonWise account, browser OAuth, and available course credits.
Uses the PersonWise hosted service and may upload selected training materials.
Does not create administrator, configuration, or developer documentation.
Cannot safely teach interface details that supplied materials do not support.

use_cases.title: Train CRM Users
use_cases.description: Convert approved CRM guides into a practical course covering navigation, core workflows, common errors, and support paths.

use_cases.title: Support ERP Adoption
use_cases.description: Build role-specific ERP training from internal procedures while preserving documented steps and version limits.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Training
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable software course from current manuals, review each checkpoint, and publish with controlled access.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Software Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Build end-user training for [software] from the attached guide. Focus on [workflow] for [learner role] and keep the course private.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one guide and one core workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create Role-Based CRM Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [page count]-page CRM course for [role] using these guides. Cover [tasks], documented mistakes, recovery steps, and support resources.
prompt_templates.scenario: A trainer needs structured learning for a defined role.

prompt_templates.title: Build Materials-Only ERP Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Create ERP end-user training using only the selected documents. Name the taught version, verify every click path, review images, and publish by link.
prompt_templates.scenario: An organization requires strict grounding and controlled sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and Refine a Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume PersonWise run [run ID]. Review fresh state and sources, correct unsupported content, inspect changed slides, then complete the requested access target.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user must recover or refine an existing course.

output_examples.input: Create private CRM training for new account representatives from our approved user guide.
output: Resolved course: five private pages for new account representatives.
Coverage: system purpose, navigation, account updates, documented mistakes, and support.
Evidence: selected guide processed successfully and each review checkpoint passed.
Delivery: login-required course link with current run and project identifiers.

output_examples.input: Build materials-only ERP training from the two selected manuals and share it with our implementation team.
output: Grounding: both manuals retained as required sources.
Course: role-specific workflow steps with no unsupported interface details.
Review: outline, script, and required slide images checked.
Delivery: playable link-access course for the implementation team.

output_examples.input: Resume the paused course and fix any unsupported steps before publication.
output_examples.output: The paused run was reviewed against its sources, corrected with one bounded revision, rechecked, and published only after playable state was confirmed.

best_practices: Provide current guides, exact software versions, learner roles, and required workflows.
Choose materials-only mode when every course statement must come from supplied documents.
Review the final access mode and course link before distributing training.
anti_patterns: Do not request invented screens, permissions, features, or click paths.
Do not use this skill for administrator setup or developer documentation.
Do not upload unapproved local files or publish beyond the requested audience.

faq.question: What source materials work best?
faq.answer: Current user guides, process documents, approved screenshots, and task instructions work best. Sources should identify the software version and intended learner.

faq.question: Can it create training without documents?
faq.answer: Yes, it can use an open topic workflow. Strict software instructions remain safest when supported by supplied materials.

faq.question: Does it support CRM and ERP systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports end-user CRM and ERP training when the request identifies learner tasks and provides reliable product guidance.

faq.question: Does it require PersonWise?
faq.answer: Yes. Course creation requires the PersonWise CLI, hosted service, browser authentication, and sufficient account credits.

faq.question: Can learners ask questions during the course?
faq.answer: Yes. PersonWise courses can present through a digital human and answer voice questions grounded in the course content.

faq.question: Can the course be shared publicly?
faq.answer: The skill supports private and link access. It changes access only when requested and reports the final link type clearly.
